subject: Initial procurement kickoff — manual account repair request for Orbit Supplies
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@orbit-supplies.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood onboarding kickoff — next steps to get Orbit Supplies into procurement portals

Hi Liam —

Thanks for taking the initial call yesterday. We're ready to kick off onboarding Orbit Supplies so your invoices and POs flow into our systems (we support Ariba and Coupa for this account). To avoid delays, can you please confirm the following in a reply:

- Legal entity name (as registered)
- W-9 or equivalent tax document (attach PDF)
- Bank account details for ACH (routing/account) + banking contact
- Primary billing email and AP contact name/phone
- Which portal you prefer (Ariba or Coupa) — if no preference we'll default to Ariba

I'll loop in Marissa (enablement) and Ben (procurement ops) to handle the portal invite and any manual provisioning if account creation fails.

If you get an account invite from Ariba/Coupa, please don't accept it until we confirm the vendor record — we've seen duplicate supplier records block PO assignment.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0198

From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@orbit-supplies.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding kickoff — next steps to get Orbit Supplies into procurement portals

Hi Jordan —

Thanks, and apologies for the slow reply — attached is our supplier packet (orbit-supplier-forms.pdf). Our legal name is Orbit Supplies, Inc. I attached the W-9 and the bank letter.

Quick heads-up: I tried completing the Ariba invite this morning and got an error at the final step — it said "Account claim mismatch: entity not eligible for invitation". I took a screenshot (orbit-error-screenshot.png). We haven't registered on Coupa yet. Happy to be added to either system, but we need the vendor record created so POs can be issued.

Liam O'Connell
Head of Operations
Orbit Supplies
liam.oconnell@orbit-supplies.com
+44 7700 900123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@orbit-supplies.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Redwood onboarding kickoff — manual provisioning request created

Jordan/Ben —

Thanks for the packet, Liam. I reviewed the screenshot — that error usually means the Ariba tenant is rejecting the claim because an existing supplier record has a slightly different legal entity formatting (e.g., "Orbit Supplies LLC" vs "Orbit Supplies, Inc."). We'll open a manual provisioning request with the Ariba team and also create a temporary Coupa vendor record to avoid blocking your first PO.

Plan:
1) I'll submit a manual vendor creation request to our marketplace ops with the attached docs and request the specific legal name "Orbit Supplies, Inc." (target SLA 3 business days).
2) Ben — can you provision a Coupa vendor placeholder so purchasing can issue an initial PO? If Coupa acceptances succeed we can route the first PO there and reconcile later.
3) Liam — please confirm the billing email and the AP contact's direct line so we populate the portal correctly.

Attachments: orbit-supplier-forms.pdf, orbit-error-screenshot.png

Marissa Cole
Enablement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@orbit-supplies.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:41:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Redwood onboarding kickoff — manual provisioning request created

Quick update — manual request submitted to vendor-ops (PROC ticket PROC-4821). I included the supplier packet and the error screenshot in the ticket. Vendor-ops confirmed they can create the Ariba record manually but will need one additional confirmation:

- Can Orbit confirm the exact tax jurisdiction (state/country) to match the Ariba entity?

If we get that, vendor-ops will:
- Create the Ariba supplier record with exact legal name
- Send a DocuSign authorisation link to Orbit for banking confirmation (link: https://docusign.com/Envelope/ABC123456789)
- Provision a Coupa placeholder record (to be retired once Ariba is active)

Liam — if you can reply with the tax jurisdiction and reconfirm the AP contact, I'll mark this ready and share the PROC ticket number and expected completion window (typically 48-72 hours once vendor-ops begins).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
+1 650-555-0123
